column1: # tools/fuzz_floors.tsv: the floor each fuzz target's run must reach (tools/check_fuzz_stats.py).
#   min_cov: half the lowest libFuzzer "INITED cov" seen for the target on any leg that fuzzed real
#     code. A harness that reaches nothing (a no-op build prints "INITED cov: 1") is under it.
#   min_units_per_second: a tenth of the lowest executed-units rate seen on any leg; times the
#     seconds the leg asked for, it is the least stat::number_of_executed_units a run may report.
# Measured 2026-11-12: fuzz-nightly run 43174481713 (Linux asan+ubsan, MSan, macOS and Windows legs,
# 900 s each; the macOS and Windows uring_recvmsg and gateway_netlink legs at cov 1 left out, as
# no-ops) and tools/fuzz_ndebug.sh --seconds 30 on hetzner2 (NDEBUG, every target but xdp_filter).
# The halving and the tenth are margins, not measurements: a leg that lands under a floor is either
# broken or slower than anything seen; read its log before moving the floor.
# A new target needs a row: a target with no row is refused.
# rocketnet_fuzz_session_raw, 2026-11-12, bench-nyc-1 (tools/fuzz_ndebug.sh --seconds 30, twice): INITED cov 3724 and
# 3721, executed units 1704 and 1250 in 31 s. min_cov is half of 3721. min_units_per_second is DERIVED, not measured on
# the slow legs: rocketnet_fuzz_session ran 2133 units the same way, so 0.63 x 1250/2133 = 0.37, rounded down. PROVISIONAL:
# the asan+ubsan, MSan, macOS and Windows legs are not yet measured; replace both figures from the first fuzz-nightly.
# xdp_filter: no nightly leg had run it; measured by replaying fuzz-nightly.yml's fuzz job for it on
